title: Project Overview
description: Understand-Anything is a codebase analysis skill suite that generates interactive knowledge graphs from source code. It uses a multi-phase pipeline to scan, analyze, and visualize codebase structure, dependencies, and architecture.

title: Core Pipeline Scripts
description: The heart of the analysis pipeline. scan-project.mjs enumerates files and detects languages/categories. extract-import-map.mjs resolves imports via tree-sitter. compute-batches.mjs groups files into semantic batches. merge-batch-graphs.py combines batch outputs into a unified graph.

title: Graph Assembly and Validation
description: After batch analysis, merge-subdomain-graphs.py combines subdomain graphs, build-fingerprints.mjs creates structural baselines for incremental updates, and extract-structure.mjs extracts detailed structure from source files.

title: Ignore Configuration
description: generate-ignore.mjs creates starter .understandignore files from @understand-anything/core defaults, helping users control which files are excluded from analysis.

title: Domain Analysis
description: The domain-analysis skill extracts business domain context from codebases, providing a domain flow graph that complements the knowledge graph.

title: Knowledge Processing
description: The knowledge-processing skill handles merging knowledge graphs and parsing knowledge bases (Karpathy-pattern LLM wikis) into interactive graph visualizations.

title: Language and Framework References
description: The pipeline uses language-specific guidance files (languages/) and framework-specific addendums (frameworks/) to inform the architecture analyzer about edge patterns, node types, and summary conventions.

title: User Interfaces: Chat, Dashboard, Diff, Explain, Onboard
description: These sub-skills provide user-facing interfaces: chat-based codebase querying, interactive dashboard visualization, git diff analysis, code explanation, and onboarding guide generation.

title: Configuration
description: Configuration files control the analysis behavior, including output language, auto-update settings, and intermediate analysis artifacts.
